goal: Create a self-contained 3D neon portal web demo (index.html, or index.html + engine3d.js + scene.js + app.js) with a software 3D renderer on a full-viewport <canvas id="c">, dark radial-gradient space background, a two-tier platform, twin pillars, lintel and crown cap (36 box faces), six orbiting octahedral crystals (48 triangles), a portal core with two counter-rotating rings, a cyber grid floor, 180 twinkling stars, 110 rising particles, an orbiting camera, and a glassmorphism HUD (NEON PORTAL 3D, FPS/POLYS/PARTS, Pause/Orbit ON/Reset buttons, speed slider).
verify_commands: node -e 'const fs=require("fs"),cp=require("child_process"),os=require("os"),path=require("path");const html=fs.readFileSync("index.html","utf8");for(const s of ["NEON PORTAL 3D","FPS","POLYS","PARTS","Pause","Reset"]){if(!html.includes(s))throw new Error("Missing: "+s);}if(!/<canvas[^>]*id=["\x27]c["\x27]/.test(html))throw new Error("Missing canvas#c");const scripts=[...html.matchAll(/<script(?![^>]*\bsrc=)[^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/script>/gi)].map(m=>m[1]);let checked=0;for(const s of scripts){if(!s.trim())continue;const p=path.join(os.tmpdir(),"neon_portal_inline_"+checked+".js");fs.writeFileSync(p,s);cp.execFileSync("node",["--check",p],{stdio:"inherit"});checked++;}for(const f of ["engine3d.js","scene.js","app.js"]){if(fs.existsSync(f)){cp.execFileSync("node",["--check",f],{stdio:"inherit"});checked++;}}if(checked===0)throw new Error("No JS found to check");console.log("OK checked="+checked);'
constraints: Full-viewport <canvas id="c"> fills the browser window.
Background uses a dark radial-gradient space theme.
Software 3D renderer sorts faces using painter's depth algorithm.
Portal monument has 6 boxes (36 faces): two-tier platform, twin pillars, lintel, crown cap.
Six orbiting octahedral crystals total 48 triangles.
Portal core glows inside the arch.
Two counter-rotating 3D neon rings surround the portal core.
Cyber perspective grid floor renders beneath the monument.
Camera orbits the portal automatically when Orbit is ON.
Mouse drag rotates the orbiting camera.
HUD displays live FPS, POLYS, PARTS counters.
HUD provides Pause, Orbit ON, Reset buttons.
Demo is self-contained with zero external dependencies.
